title: Home Design: Decorate House
description:
Welcome to renovation game, where all your dreams come true! Renovate and decorate your home and solve challenging puzzles with this relaxing match 3 design game!

If you ever dreamed of having a mansion of your own, now’s your chance in this redecor game! Move into your mansion with tons of rooms, gardens, swimming pools, playgrounds, and decorating this house! Everything you can imagine you’d find in a house decor we got it here!

Home Design: Decorate House is not just a home decoration and matching game:
•A combination of match 3 game puzzles plus home decorating gameplay brings you an overwhelming fun gaming experience!
•Design, decorate, unlock new rooms, plenty of house areas to renovate, never get bored!
•All mansion makeover needs is a brilliant mind of a talented designer like you!

Decorate the library, kitchen, garden, tennis court, swimming pool and many more house areas to come! Help her renovate dream house to make it the best manor in town in this puzzle game!

title: Jewels Blitz 6
description: Jewels Blitz 6, the long-awaited 6th installment of the legendary Match 3 game that takes you deep into the mystery of ancient cultures of Central America. You will explore Mayan Temples and try to solve their secrets and mysteries. Enjoy hundreds of levels, Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges. Earn gold and magical items!

title: Mahjong Match
description: Immerse yourself in our brain games, each level waiting for your mahjong match strategic touch. Your objective? Match three mahjongs of the same color to clear the board puzzle. With every  level presenting an array of mahjong tiles and brain games, the excitement of puzzle games will never wane.

title: Garden Tales 4
description: Garden Tales 4 is one of the most anticipated Match 3 releases of the year. This long-awaited 4th sequel boasts 4,000+ incredible levels full of fun and adventure! Your longtime friend gnome Willy needs your help with collecting flowers, fruits and mushrooms in his magical garden. The more flowers and fruits of the same kind you combine, the cooler the extras you get in the game. Turn on the famous catchy soundtrack and dive into this magical adventure in the best Match 3 game there is!

title: Candy Rain 8
description: Candy Rain 8, one of greatest Match 3 games of all time! It’s the only Match 3 Game to ever have the lucky 8 sequels! Because of its huge popularity, the players simply asked for more and we delivered. Candy Rain 8 is the deepest Candy Rain game we have ever made - with more levels, more candies, more waffles, more chests of coins and fun packed saga map to enjoy!

title: Wild West Match 3
description: Saddle up for a Wild West adventure in Bubble Shooter Wild West! Join Sheriff Bonnie as you pop colorful bubbles to defend your frontier town. Travel through dusty deserts, lively saloons, and scenic canyons while enjoying toe-tapping country tunes. Track your progress with detailed stats showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With its vibrant Western visuals and exciting challenges, this bubble shooter brings cowboy spirit to every pop!

title: Wonders of Egypt Match 2
description: Wonders of Egypt Match 2 returns with a brand-new Match-3 adventure in Ancient Egypt! Travel with your loyal Sphinx through pyramids, temples, palaces, and towering obelisks. Match 3+ sparkling gems to uncover treasures, artifacts, and hidden secrets. Conquer hundreds of fresh levels, complete tricky goals, and use powerful boosters when you need a helping hand. Earn dazzling rewards and prove your skills as the mysteries of the desert unfold in every chapter! Ready to play? Step in and match!

title: Jewels Blitz Legends
description: Embark on a dazzling adventure in Jewels Blitz Legends, the epic sequel to the beloved Match 3 hit! Travel through ancient Inca temples, uncover mystical secrets, and match colorful gems to unlock treasures. Explore Machu Picchu, complete hundreds of challenging levels, and take on exciting daily missions and weekly events. Collect gold, magical artifacts, and experience stunning visuals in this addictive journey through the heart of ancient legend!

title: Forest Match 4
description: Forest Match 4 is back with the highly anticipated fourth chapter of the beloved Match 3 series! Return to the enchanting forest to collect juicy fruits, uncover hidden coin chests, and discover sparkling gems across 4,620+ exciting levels. Follow your fairy guide back to the charming village and journey along a beautifully crafted saga map. Can you complete level goals with limited moves? Use powerful boosters when you need an extra push.

title: Fish Story 4
description: Fish Story 4 returns with its biggest underwater Match-3 adventure yet! Dive into over 4,500+ colorful levels packed with fun challenges, clever puzzles, and sparkling ocean treasures. Join your friend Mermaid on Daily Missions to earn coins, boosters, and special rewards every time you play. Take part in exciting Treasure Hunt events and uncover hidden pirate loot beneath the waves. Relax, match, and explore the deep blue sea!

title: Forest Match 3
description: Explore the enchanting world of Forest Match 3, the third sequel to the ultimate Match 3 game! Embark on an adventure through a magical forest full of fruits, hidden coin chests and surprises in 4000+ incredible levels. Your journey begins in a charming village, guided by a fairy and a saga map. Can you match forest fruits while achieving level-specific goals using limited moves? Use boosters for extra help. Forest Match 3 is your ticket to a magical match-3 adventure!

title: PoppyTile
description: PoppyTile is a soothing and delightful tile-matching puzzle game set in a peaceful, picturesque countryside farm full of charm!

title: Jungle Match Adventures
description: Jungle Match Adventures is a brand-new Match-3 game set deep in the lush Amazon Rainforest. Join the fearless explorer Aria as she uncovers hidden treasures, ancient relics, and precious gems buried in the jungle. Match colorful stones and nature-themed items, solve fun and challenging puzzles, and unlock secrets along the way. Take part in Daily and Weekly Challenges, enjoy Daily Surprises, and progress through hundreds of exciting levels in this unforgettable jungle adventure.

title: Wild West Match 2: The Gold Rush
description: Wild West Match 2 immerses you in the thrilling Gold Rush era of the Wild West! Match three or more gold nuggets, cowboy hats, horseshoes, and other treasures to earn points and unlock new levels. Use Dynamite to clear obstacles or reveal hidden gold! With hundreds of challenging levels, you’ll dig through the Wild West to find hidden treasures and secrets. Ready to strike it rich? Join the Gold Rush adventure now!

title: Yummy Tales 4
description: Join Oscar, the clever farm dog, in Yummy Tales 4 - a delightful Match 3 adventure full of fresh farm fun! Swap and match tasty fruits, colorful veggies, and charming treats to complete level goals and keep your hungry farm animals happy. Explore a lively world packed with clever puzzles, daily rewards, exciting challenges, and helpful boosters. With plenty of surprises waiting along the way, Yummy Tales 4 brings a brand-new harvest of puzzle fun. Start playing now!

title: Farm Match Seasons 2
description: Farm Match Seasons 2 is one of the new Match 3 games from the creators of the legendary Garden Tales, Forest Match and Solitaire Farm Seasons. Your friend Poppy needs your help to look after the most beautiful farm in the village. Together you will harvest strawberries, collect flowers and protect butterflies on their farm fields. What is important that you keep the farm free from weeds! The second sequel features a BIG content update with new levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy!

title: Tropical Match 2
description: Tropical Match is back with its highly anticipated second sequel! Join your island friend Coco for a colorful Match 3 adventure in a lush tropical paradise. Match juicy fruits, vibrant flowers, and clear away algae and clouds across 1,250+ exciting levels. Complete Daily Missions and discover tropical treasures along the way! With relaxing island tunes and gorgeous scenery, this is the perfect summer escape. Dive in and start your tropical adventure today!

title: Wonders of Egypt Match
description: Begin a legendary journey in Wonders of Egypt Match, a thrilling Match 3 game set in Ancient Egypt! Join your guide, the Amara, as you match three or more gems and artifacts to uncover hidden treasures and secrets buried in pyramids, temples, and obelisks. With stunning visuals and immersive soundscapes, explore a world filled with ancient mysteries and challenges. Ready to prove your skills? Join the adventure and experience the wonders of Egypt today!

title: Cake Sorting Deluxe
description: Cake Sorting Deluxe is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that challenges your sorting skills! Shift cakes across shelves to make matches of three or more. Clear the board, uncover hidden and shadowed cakes, and solve tricky puzzles as you go. With cute visuals, smooth gameplay, and lots of sweet challenges, Cake Sorting Deluxe is a treat for anyone who loves a good puzzle. Ready to mix, match, and clear the shelves?

title: Kings and Queens Match
description: Welcome to Kings and Queens Match! Dive into a magical kingdom , matching jewels and crowns to progress through levels. Unleash Royal Bombs, hammers, and wands for extra fun. Stunning graphics and an enchanting soundtrack will transport you to a world of magic and wonder. So what are you waiting for? Join Princess Bella on her quest for treasure and adventure today!

title: Royal Garden Match 2
description: Royal Garden Match 2 is here! Join Aria as she tends the kingdom’s most prestigious Royal Garden. Restore it to its former glory by completing fun match-3 puzzles! Match royal flowers, fruits, and plants across hundreds of levels packed with daily missions and challenges. Enjoy a magical journey full of beauty, strategy, and rewards. Play Royal Garden Match 2 now and bring the Royal Garden back to life!

title: Athena Match 2
description: Athena Match 2 - the epic sequel returns! Join the goddess Athena on a new mythical journey through ancient Greece. Match 3 or more legendary artifacts to restore temples and unlock the secrets of the gods. Enjoy stunning visuals, immersive sound, and hundreds of new levels packed with daily missions and challenges. Step into the world of Greek mythology and prove your match-3 skills in this divine adventure!

title: Hawaii Match 5
description: Escape to the paradise in Hawaii Match 5! Explore dreamlike landscapes while matching exotic fruits and flowers. With over 4000+ levels, complete challenging goals in limited moves by forming rows of five or more symbols. Unlock powerful boosters and combine symbols for explosive bonuses. Discover hidden treasures and let your soul unwind in this captivating island adventure. Play Hawaii Match 5 now and enjoy endless fun!

title: Forgotten Treasure 2 - Match 3
description: In this puzzle game you need to combine jewels to crash obstacles using your logic. Enjoy Forgotten Treasure 2 – Match 3! There are different modes: you can go through exciting adventures: collect treasures, help the deer return the Christmas mood decorating the Christmas tree! In addition to adventures, you can pass seasonal packs, for each of which you collect different ingredients, and with them you can create the most beautiful relics!

title: Cookie Land
description: Step into Cookie Land, the ultimate sweet Match 3 adventure! Match cookies, candies, pies, donuts, cupcakes, and cotton candies to clear the board and trigger scrumptious chain reactions. Explore a fairytale-like saga map filled with colorful sweets, charming graphics, and a catchy soundtrack. With new treats raining down and endless levels of fun, Cookie Land is the most addictive, mouth-watering Match 3 game for all sweet lovers!

title: Travel Story Match
description: Embark on a global adventure with Travel Story Match! Match 3 identical travel items to complete exciting puzzles. Use powerful boosters to tackle tricky combinations, explore iconic destinations, and uncover hidden gems. Complete Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges, collect rewards, and enjoy hundreds of thrilling levels. Start your journey now and create your very own unforgettable travel story!

title: Juicy Match 2
description: Juicy Match 2 returns with even more natural, fresh, and juicy fun! Step into the best Juice Bar in town and match delicious fruits to create perfect juice blends. Your cheerful Banana friend will guide you with helpful tips along the way. Match three or more fruits to juice them, trigger chain reactions for big bonuses, and master hundreds of new levels. With Daily Missions, Weekly Challenges, and endless juicy puzzles, the adventure never stops in Juicy Match 2!

title: Candy Match 4
description: The long-awaited sequel to our popular Match 3 game! Candy Match 4 takes you on a delightful journey through the world of delicious candies. With incredible 4000+ levels you will enjoy endless fun combining candies, completing Daily Missions and Challenges, and discovering gifts along the way. Meet your friend Luffy the cat, who helps you navigate through tricky blockers and master the game. Experience one of the best Match 3 games ever!

title: Hawaii Match 4
description: Hawaii Match 4 will take you on a journey through the beautiful nature of Hawaii. You will explore magical islands, collect exotic fruits and flowers and have endless fun completing New Daily and Weekly Challenges. Play Hawaii Match 4 now and enjoy 3000+ brand new levels!

title: Kings and Queens Match 2
description: Kings and Queens Match 2 is one of the most anticipated Match 3 sequels! This long-awaited second chapter features 2,500+ incredible levels full of magic and adventure. Join Princess Bella on a magical adventure, matching jewels and crowns to uncover hidden treasures. Create powerful boosters like Royal Bombs, hammers, and arrows to clear obstacles and win big. Stunning graphics and an enchanting soundtrack bring the kingdom to life. Get ready for a royal journey full of fun and surprises!

title: Mansion Story Match
description: Step into Mansion Story Match, a captivating Match-3 adventure set inside a grand and mysterious mansion. Explore hidden rooms, uncover long-forgotten secrets, and discover dazzling treasures. Solve hundreds of challenging puzzles, match gems, and collect rare relics as you reveal an intriguing story. From dusty attics to lush gardens, every corner holds a surprise. Begin your journey now and uncover the secrets within!

title: Juicy Match
description: Tired of candies? Dive into Juicy Match and explore a world of natural, fresh, and juicy delights! You run the best Juice Bar in town, where you match a variety of fruits, from tropical to classic, to create the perfect juice blends. Your cheerful friend, Tiki will guide you with tips and tricks. Match three or more identical fruits to juice them and complete levels. Create chain reactions for extra bonuses and points. Enjoy a refreshing, juicy adventure with Juicy Match!

title: Athena Match
description: Embark on a mythical journey in Athena Match, a Match 3 game set in Ancient Greece. Guided by the goddess Athena, match three or more identical artifacts to clear levels and uncover Greek secrets. Stunning visuals and rich soundscapes bring this world to life as you solve puzzles and overcome mythical obstacles inspired by Greek lore. Ready to prove your skills? Join Athena and dive into the adventure!

title: Farm Match Seasons
description: Farm Match Seasons is a brand new Match 3 Game from the creators of the legendary games like Garden Tales, Forest Match and Solitaire Farm Seasons. Together with your friend Poppy, a little farm girl, you will look after the most beautiful farm in the village! Harvest strawberries, collect flowers and protect butterflies on your farm fields. Don't forget to keep your farm free from weeds! So what are you waiting for? Turn on the catchy soundtrack and enjoy this fantastic brand new Match 3 game!

title: Fish Story 3
description: Welcome to Fish Story 3! Immerse yourself in 4,000+ levels of Match 3 excitement guided by our mermaid host. Solve puzzles, conquer Daily Missions, and unlock treasures in the Daily Challenge. Dive into addictive challenges and return daily for rewards. Join the underwater adventure now!

title: Aqua Blitz 2
description: Welcome to Aquablitz 2 - the newest iteration of the beloved underwater match-3 game that comes with fresh new graphics, a catchy tune and lots of improvements! Meet your new hostess, Pearl, the little mermaid. She will be pleased to guide you on your adventure through more than 700 splashy levels and teach you all the tricks you need to know to solve even the most complicated puzzles.

title: Magic and Wizards Match
description: Magic and Wizards is an enchanting Match 3 game where you and your friend Aurora embark on a mystical journey through a magical realm. With over 4000+ levels, match gems representing magical elements to overcome obstacles, using powerful boosters to progress. Complete Daily Missions, tackle tricky blockers, and uncover hidden treasures. With stunning graphics and immersive gameplay, Magic & Wizards delivers a captivating experience filled with mystery. Ready for your magical adventure?

title: Jewel Legend
description: Let the great Jewel Legend begin! Travelers from all around the world have come to the mines to dig those diamonds out. Join them in the effort to find as many diamonds as possible while engaging in various challenges that will keep you entertained for long stretches of time! So, what are you waiting for?

title: Candy Rain 5
description: Get ready for a delightful and vibrant match-3 experience with Candy Rain 5! The beloved Candy Rain series continues with even more sugary fun and challenging puzzles to enjoy.

title: Dog Puzzle Story 3
description: Dog Puzzle Story is back with a third instalment of fun! Join your beloved friend, the cute puppy Charlie on another adventurous journey in a winter theme! Play colourful Match 3 puzzles full of toys, dog pillows and treats scattered all over the garden in more than 4000+ incredible levels! Help Charlie to put all the items in the right place and dig up all the bones! This is going to be so much fun!

title: Tropical Match
description: Embark on a vibrant adventure in Tropical Match 3! Help Coco, your lively island guide, find fruits and other island gems in a tropical paradise. Match exotic fruits, uncover vibrant flowers and observe colourful exotic birds while enjoying the island adventure. The game features exciting levels and a relaxing island soundtrack! So what are you waiting for? Enjoy the tropical paradise adventure now!

title: Royal Garden Match
description: Welcome to Royal Garden Match! You’ve inherited a grand Royal Castle and a once-beautiful garden—now it’s up to you to bring its beauty to life! Solve exciting match-3 puzzles by combining exquisite royal flowers, fruits, and plants to unlock powerful boosters. With hundreds of challenging levels, unique royal characters, and a magical journey ahead, there's always something new to discover. Can you make the royal garden flourish? Play now and start your enchanting adventure!

title: The Lost City - Match 3
description:
Hit three in a row and get a crazy field explosion!
Use colorful booster effects that will make the game even more fun and colorful!
No stressful time restrictions! Enjoy the adventure freely!
Go through a wide selection of mysterious and mystical stages.
Complete various levels and get happiness from breaking gems!

title: Match Dream Garden
description: What a beautiful garden! Match leaves, flowers, apples and other items to progress. Use power-ups like the Hammer to remove any piece, the Rake to clear an entire row or column, or the Gardening Gloves to swap two pieces.

title: Supermarket Sort N Match
description: In 'Supermarket Sort n Match,' rearrange items between shelves to match 3 identical items on one shelf, clearing it and allowing upper shelves to slide down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves. Collect all items before time runs out as difficulty increases with each level. Enjoy the ultimate item-sorting and matching challenge!

title: My Little City
description: My Little City is the latest Match-3 challenge for aspiring city planners! The City Council has commissioned your company to prepare countless new building plots for construction. They need you to ensure the construction projects go according to plan! Supply building materials such as stones, water, electricity, and more! Use various boosters like sledgehammers, dynamite, or paint bombs to complete tasks on time. Play My Little City for free now and build your own Little City!

title: Hawaii Match 6
description: Escape to paradise in Hawaii Match 6! Explore beautiful island landscapes while matching exotic fruits, flowers, and tropical treasures. Complete fun and challenging goals in limited moves by combining symbols and creating powerful bonuses. Unlock helpful boosters, discover hidden rewards, and enjoy a relaxing island adventure full of colorful puzzles. Play Hawaii Match 6 now and enjoy endless tropical fun!

title: Pool Party 3
description: Pool Party 3 is back with a highly anticipated third sequel boasting 4000+ levels! Match colorful water balloons in sets of three or more to clear levels with unique goals. Your friend Bunni is waiting for you to go on another trip to the water park together to have fun and solve puzzles! Enjoy this ultimate waterpark adventure, available for a splash of excitement anytime, anywhere!

title: Pop Fruit
description:
Pop Fruit is a bright and relaxing fruit-sorting puzzle game. Each bubble contains different fruits, and your goal is to pick the right fruits and place them into baskets. Match three identical fruits in a basket to clear them and keep the board moving.
Plan your moves carefully, because baskets have limited space.
Clear fruits, complete each level, and unlock more challenging stages with new fruit combinations.

title: Shiny Jewels
description: Conquer each level with your logic, unleash powerful boosters and claim victory! Complete missions to earn unique rewards or join special events: break the chest, collect as many coins as possible within limited moves or race against time to complete the level.

title: Animal Block Pop Puzzle
description: Animal Block Pop Puzzle is a fun puzzle game with cute animal-themed visuals. ??✨ Match 3+ animal-shaped blocks ?? on a grid to clear them and score points. As you progress, the game gets faster and adds new tile colors for a growing challenge. With easy drag-and-drop controls and vibrant graphics, it offers a relaxing yet exciting experience for all ages.

title: Wild West Match
description: Embark on a captivating Wild West adventure with Bonnie! Explore iconic landscapes, face challenges, and uncover secrets in this thrilling journey. The frontier spirit awaits – join Bonnie on the quest for an unforgettable adventure!

title: Sheep N Sheep
description:
Everyone is playing the elimination game. It is said that only 0.1% of people can clear the second level of the daily challenge! A challenge before going to bed, you can't stop!
In addition to daily challenges, we also have a classic level mode, which is easy and decompressed, and casual elimination. Play a game anytime, anywhere, and have a brainstorming competition!

title: Papa Cherry Saga
description:
Do you want to play a sweet little game? Then Papa Cherry Saga is the right one for a real sweet tooth. The main character - chef Papa Cherry will always help you to win a level. Taste the sweetness of the new fascinating match-3 game! 

Switch and match cookies in this tasty puzzle adventure to progress to the next level for that sweet winning feeling. Solve puzzles with quick thinking and smart moves, and be rewarded with delicious cascades and tasty combos!
Plan your moves by matching 3 or more cookies in a row. Match four or more cookies to create power-ups. Use boosters if you are stuck. Can’t win the level? Use five extra moves at the end of the game! Blast through the chocolate blocks and marshmallows to collect cookies across dozens of levels, guaranteed to have you craving more!

title: The Sorting Mart
description: The Sorting Mart is a store sorting puzzle game that lets you experience the fun of shopping in a store. Rearrange items between shelves to match three identical ones on a shelf, clearing it and letting the upper shelves drop down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves and keep matching before time runs out. If you get stuck, use the shuffle button to mix up the shelves and find matches more easily. Challenge your sorting skills as levels become more difficult!

title: Grill It All
description: Grill it all is a cooking-themed match-3 puzzle game. Play as a grill expert, matching identical skewers to complete orders. Strategically arrange ingredients like fish, leeks, and meatballs on grills. Test your observation and speed while using upgrade tools for strategic depth!

title: Match Masters
description: Match Masters is a real-time multiplayer match-3 puzzle game where players compete head-to-head on the same board. Each move requires strategic thinking, as it can benefit both you and your opponent. Utilize unique boosters, participate in tournaments, and climb the global leaderboards in this dynamic and engaging game.

title: KrisMas Tiles
description: Collect presents in Krismas Tiles! In this Christmas Tiles game you must click on groups of tiles to blast them away. Stuck playing this christmas cards game? Then use a Krismas Bomb!

title: Diamondz
description: DiamondZ is a special variant of Match-3. Here, the goal is not to directly manipulate jewels on the board but to insert them on the left or right side to eliminate groups and make diamonds fall into the mine carts. Help the little miner collect as much wealth as possible!

title: SpelunKing
description: Dig into this deep match-3 expedition! Take a dive underground, search for your grandpa’s lost items, and collect precious stones to help the villagers around town rebuild Farnsbury. Upgrade buildings and unlock new facilities as you match deeper! Reach the bottom of the mine and become the Spelunk King (or Queen)!

title: Match Find 3D
description:
Are you a master player of finding games?Do you enjoy matching puzzle games?Come to challenge this addictive puzzle game - Match Find 3D!
Unique gameplay, a combination of collecting and matching, and well-designed levels that will keep you entertained.

title: Molang Match'n Munch
description:
Join Molang and Piu Piu in a heartwarming match-3 adventure! Travel the world, collect rare ingredients, and solve sweet puzzles to save the lost recipes in the Great Book of Flavors before they vanish forever!
Travel through the world's greatest real and imaginary cities, collect rare ingredients, and solve delicious match-3 puzzles to advance and save these culinary treasures!

title: Tasty Jewel
description: This box of sweets contains precious jewel candies! Match and combine them to craft exploding ones! It can help you crush through blocks standing in your way. The classic turn based match-3 arcade with lots of challenging levels and modes awaits you!

title: Frogtastic
description:
Frogtastic is a HTML5 puzzle game freely inspired to Zuma gameplay. 
Enjoy this premium game with 13 levels of increasing difficulty. 
Make combo and destroy all the balls before they reach the dip!

title: Shelf Shift Match
description: Test your strategy and speed in Shelf Shift Match! Shift items on the shelves to create perfect matches of three, clearing the way to reveal hidden shadowed items. But beware—unwise moves can block your shelves, leaving no space to shift and leading to game over! If you're stuck, use the shuffle button to mix things up and find new matches.

title: Toy Match
description: Toy Match is a delightful match-three game with charming graphics that appeal to all ages.

title: Screw Jam - Fun Puzzle Game
description:
Remove screws in correct order to get rid of the boards. 
Match the removed screws and complete the level. 
Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: Royal Jewels Match
description: Matching jewels has never been so much fun! Unlock unique levels, participate in special events and take on surprising challenges. Collect coins with your matches and show off your decorating skills. Earn crowns as you progress and become a true master of the game!

title: Jewel Christmas Story
description: The most anticipated holiday of the year is here! Christmas is just around the corner and lots of holiday fun full of gifts and sweets is waiting for you in this new match3 game. Collect game currency, achieve combos, and use boosters in various missions.

title: Jewel Miner Quest
description: The dazzling world of gems awaits! Participate in thrilling events within limited moves or time. Solve captivating puzzles, complete fun tasks, and enjoy daily bonuses. Discover many terrific surprises with every move and see how far you can go.

title: Jewel Garden Story
description: Enter a dazzling realm where sparkling jewels await your matching skills. Challenge yourself to achieve high scores and enjoy the visually stunning jewel combinations. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless entertainment.

title: Shelf Sweep
description:
Get ready to tidy up the shelves in Shelf Sweep!
Dive into a fun and addictive sorting puzzle game where your goal is to clean up messy shelves layer by layer. Only the outermost layer of items is visible—clear them by matching three identical items, and reveal the hidden treasures beneath!

title: Jewel Dress Up
description: Each puzzle brings you closer to unlocking fabulous fashionable combinations. Use power-ups to overcome challenges and to express your style, all while enjoying a relaxing and engaging gameplay. Can you create the perfect look?

title: 3 Tiles
description:
Cutely shaped picture tiles are mixed and stacked. 
Find the tiles in the same picture from the top and group them together. 
Clear the stages by removing tiles from all fields!

title: Sea Rush
description: Use your imagination and discover what the ocean holds. Rescue all the fishes that are scattered in the levels and see all of their beautifull colors.

title: Home Design - Match 3
description: Enjoy a perfect blend of home design and match-3 fun! Solve colorful puzzles, create your ideal home, and activate powerful boosters. Take on rewarding challenges, collect prizes, and personalize your interiors. Play anytime, anywhere!

title: Brilliant Jewels
description: Brilliant Jewels is a Match 3 game where you can either play against the time or try to pass levels with limited amount of moves. If you are feeling confident, you can also challenge the hard mode on the time attack mode. This game doesn't lack any sparkle!

title: Queen of Mahjong
description:
Plunge into the atmosphere of a magical world in a new game in the style of Mahjong Connect. Discover several worlds of objects by finding identical pairs of different items!

Queen of Mahjong is an amazing game that will give you moments of pleasure.

title: Guinea Piggy Matching
description:
Guinea Piggy Match uses well known and easy to learn game mechanics. Your target is to take apart a pattern made of tiles. 
For each completed level, you are given a golden puzzle piece. For these, you can uncover images of cute guinea piggies.

title: Triple Sort 3D Home Design
description: Welcome to the world of Triple Sort 3D: Home Design, where matching meets decorating! Dive in the puzzle-solving with and begin crafting a virtual space of your dreams. Get ready to transform ugly and cluttered rooms  into clean and cozy spaces! Discover the perfect blend of challenges, creativity, and an epic makeover journey that awaits you!

title: Hexa Stack Christmas
description: Get into the holiday spirit with Hexa Stack Christmas: a festive twist on the classic hexagon-stacking puzzle game. Place the Christmas-themed hexagon tiles stacks onto the board and sort the same color tiles to collect them. The game combines a light puzzle that requires attention and logic — perfect for relaxing while stimulating your brain. 2 game modes, infinite levels, a user-friendly interface, and save support let you play anytime without losing progress.

title: Popping Candies
description: Match and crush candies to achieve goals in this addictive puzzle game! Swap adjacent candies to form rows of three or more and clear the board. Create special candies like striped, wrapped, or color bombs to enhance your progress. Overcome obstacles like chocolate and blockers while completing each level's unique objectives. Be mindful of your limited moves! Use boosters for extra assistance and advance through challenging levels to unlock new stages.

title: Gold Mine Strike Christmas
description: Gold Mine Strike Christmas brings a new way of playing Gold Strike with a Christmas flavor. Throw candy canes, get rid of packages and use powerups to enhance your progress. The gold you acquire is used to upgrade the powerups.

title: Kitty Match 3 puzzle game
description:
Kitty Match is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game with adorable cats. Match tiles, create combos, and clear levels in a relaxing and colorful world.

Easy to play and perfect for all ages. Enjoy smooth gameplay and endless puzzle fun.

Start your cute cat adventure now!

title: Zen Tile
description: Are you a master player of matching games? Do you enjoy matching puzzle games? Come to challenge this addictive puzzle game: Zen Tile - Relaxing Match!

title: Candy Jewels
description: It is a candy-filled puzzle adventure full of surprises! Match candies, break chests and collect coins as you progress through countless levels. Complete fun events like Time Attack or Coin Catch and use boosters to overcome tricky obstacles even faster!

title: 2248 Musical
description: Once you start playing it, you will absolutely get addicted to these 2048 puzzle games. designed with beautiful graphics and intuitive gameplay, making it a great choice for those who love number block puzzle games

title: SORTSTORE
description: Swap products to match three of the same kind and fulfill customer requests. Products can be moved to empty shelves, and items in the back will move forward when the front ones are removed. Each move decreases the number of moves left, and the game ends when the move count reaches 0.

title: Screw Jam!
description:
Let's embark on a mechanical journey like no other in Screw Jam Puzzle. Your mission is to untwist screws and put them in the right screw boxes. You win when completing all the screw sets.

FEATURES
- Addictive gameplay, help you relax and train your brain
- ASMR Screw game: Beautiful design with satisfying in-game sounds

This challenging and addictive Screw jam game will put your problem-solving skills to the test as you twist, turn, and put all the screws into right screw boxes.

title: Catch The Goose
description: Catch The Goose is a puzzle elimination mini-game. Players can tap identical items to automatically send them to the bottom slot - when three matching items gather, they get eliminated. When players successfully clear all items arranged in the grid, they get to "catch" a mischievous goose. Its addictive simplicity, stress-relieving design, and playful art style have made it a cultural phenomenon.

title: Block Color Puzzle Blast
description: Immerse yourself in the explosive fun of Block Color Puzzle Blast, a thrilling puzzler where strategic block placement is key. Drag and drop vibrant blocks to fill gaps, unleash combos to earn massive scores, and experience the satisfying blast as completed lines clear the board, challenging you to reach new heights in colorful puzzle mastery.
